text:
Gold Price in 2023
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2023, the LBMA gold price rose 8.0% between 2023-01-31 ($1,924) and 2023-12-28 ($2,078). The highest sampled price was $2,078 in December and the lowest was $1,825 in February. The mean of these observations was $1,957. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
